response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, senior-level engineer with genuine developer-tooling credentials — he built C/C++ components for the LabWindows/CVI IDE, authored a test runner and assertion library, and maintains open-source frameworks — which maps well to the 'interest in IDE internals and language tooling' requirement. However, the role's core requirements are strong Java and Kotlin with deep JVM knowledge plus solid Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience, and the resume shows almost none of this: Java appears only as a minor mention in a 2016–2018 role, Kotlin and Spring are entirely absent, and the last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. The gap on the primary technical stack is too large for a mid-senior IC hire expected to own enterprise-framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Prior IDE product development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI in C/C++)
Track record building language tooling: test runners, assertion libs, web server libs
Long, senior-level career across systems, low-latency services, and full-stack work
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience
Minimal and dated Java exposure; no evidence of deep JVM internals knowledge
Recent decade focused on TypeScript/Node and DLang, not enterprise JVM ecosystems
